source.legal_effect: Binding regulation; verify applicability and current text before use

requirements.summary: Identify the applicant, business, organization, citizenship/ownership information, license class, use, term, and related licenses.
requirements.plain_language: NRC needs to know who is applying, what they do, who controls them, and exactly which authorization is requested.
questions: What is the legal applicant name and place of organization?
Who are the principal officers and what is the foreign ownership/control position?
requirements.fact: Sample Advanced Energy Project LLC is organized in Delaware and proposes a commercial nuclear plant.
evidence_required: Formation certificate and current organizational chart

requirements.summary: Provide information sufficient to demonstrate financial qualification, including construction/fuel-cycle and first-five-years operating cost estimates, financial capacity plans, and available funding sources.
requirements.plain_language: Show how the applicant expects to fund construction, fuel-cycle needs, and the first five years of operation. Do not invent amounts in this workspace.
questions: What controlled cost estimate covers construction and related fuel-cycle costs?
What supports the financial capacity plan and available funds?
requirements.fact: The applicant asserts that a financial capacity plan exists; no accepted cost estimate or source-of-funds record is registered.
evidence_required: Controlled construction and fuel-cycle cost estimate
First five years of annual operating-cost estimates
open_issues: Registered metadata is not accepted evidence.

requirements.summary: Submit an FSAR describing the facility, operating limits, whole-plant safety analysis, site/design information, and applicant technical qualifications.
requirements.plain_language: The FSAR must contain enough controlled design, site, analysis, and qualification information for NRC to resolve safety matters before issuing a COL.
questions: What approved design and site-basis records support the FSAR scope?
Who is accountable for technical qualifications and safety analysis review?
requirements.fact: The applicant has identified an FSAR work package and a technical lead; the site-basis and safety-analysis records are draft-only.
open_issues: Draft site-basis analysis requires qualified review.

requirements.summary: Describe the QAP in the COL application; COL holders must develop, implement, and maintain a QA program under 10 CFR part 50 appendix B and use a written QA program manual.
requirements.plain_language: Describe the controlled QA program and manual that will govern quality-affecting work. A draft policy is not proof the program is implemented.
questions: What QAP manual revision is controlled for this application?
What objective evidence shows implementation and independent QA authority?
requirements.fact: A quality policy draft is available, but the controlled QAP manual and implementation record have not been accepted.
evidence_required: Independent QA authority and audit record

requirements.summary: Provide proposed inspections, tests, analyses, and acceptance criteria sufficient to provide reasonable assurance of conformity with the COL and applicable requirements.
requirements.plain_language: Define how construction and operation conformity will be checked and what acceptance criteria must be met.
questions: What ITAAC set applies to this facility and referenced approvals?
requirements.fact: The applicant has a preliminary ITAAC index; acceptance-criterion owners are not assigned.
